name: Airplane cabin
about: Seated on an airliner at cruise: the steady roar, slow beating engines, air vents and the cabin chime.

options.name: At the back, by the engines

name: Airport hall
about: A big airport terminal: rolling suitcases, footsteps, chimes and announcements over a crowd murmur.

name: Game arcade
about: A busy game arcade: machines bleeping and blasting, coins dropping, buttons mashed, and kids chattering.

name: Beehive
about: Beside a busy hive in a garden: a warm, beating hum, and bees zipping past your head.

options.name: At the hive in a garden

name: Roaring blaze
about: A big bonfire roaring and flaring, crackling loudly all across, timbers collapsing into it.

name: Blizzard
about: A howling snowstorm: freezing gusts full of hissing, ticking snow, out in it or safe inside a cabin.

name: Motor boat
about: Out on the water in a motor boat: the engine, the hull slapping the waves and the wash along the side.

name: City bus
about: Riding a city bus: the diesel growling at the back, stops, hissing doors and brakes, rattling windows.

name: Coffee shop
about: A busy coffee shop: chatter at the tables, cups and spoons clinking, the espresso machine hissing.

options.name: In the middle of the room

name: Campfire
about: A wood campfire crackling and popping, flames softly roaring, logs settling now and then.

name: Car on the highway
about: Riding in a car at highway speed: tyre roar, wind, the engine, and trucks passing by.

name: Car in the rain
about: Inside a car in the rain: drumming on the roof, drops on the windscreen, wipers swishing and the heater fan.

name: Carnival
about: A fairground at night: a band organ playing far off, crowd chatter, game bells, rides rumbling and distant screams.

name: Casino floor
about: A casino floor: slot machines chiming, coins and chips clattering, a roulette wheel, and a cheer from a table.

name: Dripping cave
about: Deep in a cave: water dripping into pools from several places, each with its own note, echoing in the dark.

name: City street
about: A busy city sidewalk: cars swishing past, horns, a far-off siren, and people walking by.

name: Ticking clock
about: A clock ticking in a quiet room, from a pocket watch to a tall case clock that can strike the hour.

name: Construction site
about: A building site: a jackhammer, hammering, a circular saw, a diesel digger and a reversing beeper.

name: Babbling creek
about: A shallow creek close by, gurgling and bubbling over the stones in several places.

name: Desert wind
about: Hot dry wind across open sand, the grains hissing in every gust, with the odd low hum of a singing dune if you like.

name: Dungeon
about: Deep under a castle: water dripping on stone, chains shifting, far groans and an iron door.

name: Eerie wavering whine
about: The wavering electric whine of old horror and space films: ghostly swoops, a strange tune or a trembling note.

name: Engine room
about: Deep in an engine room: huge machinery pounding in a steel hall, steam hissing, a pump and clanking tools.

name: Factory floor
about: A factory floor: a pounding press, a rattling conveyor, motors humming, and bursts of compressed air.

name: Farmyard morning
about: Early morning on a farm: roosters crowing, hens clucking nearby, sparrows, doves, a far cow.

name: Fireplace
about: A log fire in the hearth of a quiet room, crackling gently, the chimney drawing, logs shifting on the grate.

name: Forest birds
about: A spring wood full of birdsong: singers near and far, soft chips, a far dove, wind in the leaves.

name: Fountain
about: A fountain splashing and sparkling into its stone basin, in a quiet garden or a town square.

name: Refrigerator hum
about: A refrigerator humming in a quiet kitchen at night, with clicks, gurgles and the odd drop of ice.

name: Frog pond
about: A spring pond after dark: peepers ringing, trilling toads, twangy frogs, and the odd splash.

name: Graveyard at night
about: An old graveyard after dark: wind in bare trees, crickets, an owl, a far bell and a creaking iron gate.

name: Hail
about: Hailstones clattering and bouncing on the ground, a deck, a window, a tin roof or a car.

name: Haunted house
about: An old house at night: creaking doors and floors, steps upstairs, wind at the windows and far-off moans.

name: Heartbeat
about: A heartbeat, lub-dub, steady or racing or skipping, heard from inside, on a chest or under the floor.

name: Helicopter cabin
about: Inside a helicopter in flight: the deep rotor thump, the turbine whine, the gearbox and rushing wind.

name: Hospital ward
about: A hospital ward: a heart monitor beeping, soft footsteps, a hushed nurses station and a distant page.

name: Jungle by day
about: A steamy rainforest by day: strange bird calls, whooping far off, winding cicadas, frogs and drips.

name: Restaurant kitchen
about: A restaurant kitchen at full tilt: sizzling pans, chopping, clanging pots, the hood fan and shouted orders.

name: Laundromat
about: A laundromat: washers sloshing, dryers tumbling with buttons ticking, a spin cycle whining, coins and buzzers.

name: Library
about: A quiet library: soft air, pages turning, a whisper now and then, and footsteps on carpet.

name: Meadow at dawn
about: First light in an open meadow: a skylark high above, sweet whistles in the grass, doves far off.

name: Mountain top
about: A windy summit: gusts roaring past your ears, whistling rocks, a hawk crying far below, echoes.

name: Broken music box
about: An old music box playing a sad little waltz, out of tune, missing notes, running down and wound again.

params.name: Runs down and is wound again

name: Night crickets
about: A warm summer night: crickets near and far, katydids answering each other, a still breeze.

name: Ocean waves
about: Waves rolling onto a beach, crashing, washing up the sand and fizzing back, from calm lapping to big surf.

name: Office
about: An open office: air conditioning, keyboards clicking, phones ringing far off, a printer and quiet talk.

name: Owls in the woods
about: Dark woods at night: owls hooting and answering, a slow wind in the trees, a few insects.

name: Telephone line
about: An old phone line: a dial tone, ringing or busy signal, with hiss, hum, clicks and faint crosstalk.

name: Radio static
about: A radio between stations: hiss and crackle, whistling carriers and faded fragments of far stations.

name: Rain gutter
about: Rain running along the gutter, gurgling down the pipe and pouring out at the bottom.

name: Rain on a tin roof
about: Under a metal roof while rain drums and pings on it, with gutter drips outside.

name: Rain on a tent
about: Camping in the rain: drops patter and thump on the tent fabric, with bigger drips falling from the trees.

name: Rain on a window
about: Indoors by a window while rain taps the glass, runs off the frame and trickles down the gutter outside.

name: Rain
about: Steady rain, close enough to hear the drops, on the ground, puddles and leaves, or a surface you pick.

name: Rainforest at night
about: A tropical rainforest after dark: a wall of insects, two-note tree frogs, drips, a lonely night bird.

name: River
about: A wide river flowing past, from a smooth steady current to churning rapids.

name: Rocket launch
about: A rocket launch: ignition, a crackling roar building to full thrust, then climbing away into the sky.

name: Sailboat
about: Aboard a sailboat: wind in the rigging, a flapping sail, creaking lines, a halyard tinking and water at the hull.

name: School hallway
about: A school hallway between classes: kids chattering, lockers slamming, sneakers squeaking, and the bell.

name: Seagulls in a harbor
about: A small harbor: gulls calling and laughing, water lapping, rigging clinking, a bell buoy far out.

name: Server room
about: A server room: a wall of fans roaring, air handlers rumbling, a faint electrical hum and drive clicks.

name: Waves on rocks
about: Sea waves booming against rocks, spray falling back in a shower of drops and water gurgling out of the cracks.

name: Spaceship bridge
about: On the bridge of a starship: a deep engine drone, air humming, consoles chirping and beeping.

name: Stadium crowd
about: A big stadium crowd: a roaring murmur that swells, cheers, applause, whistles and chants.

name: Thunderstorm
about: Heavy rain and gusty wind with thunder, cracking overhead or rumbling far away.

name: Submarine
about: Inside a submarine: the low hum of the boat, sonar pings ringing into the deep, the hull groaning.

name: Subway car
about: Inside an underground train: tunnel roar, motors whining up and down, squealing curves and door chimes.

name: Subway platform
about: An underground platform: trains rumble in and out, doors chime, announcements echo off the tiles.

name: Summer field
about: A hot summer field: cicadas swelling in the trees, grasshoppers, bees buzzing past, a warm breeze.

name: Swamp at night
about: A warm swamp after dark: deep frogs booming, twangs and clicks, rasping insects, bubbling mud.

name: Crackling torch
about: A burning torch fluttering and spitting, drips of burning pitch hissing out on the floor.

options.name: A row down a stone passage

name: Train ride
about: Inside a train car: clickety-clack over the rails, the rumble of the wheels and a horn far ahead.

name: TV static
about: An old tube television tuned to nothing: the hiss of snow, the high whine and a buzz of sync.

name: Underwater
about: Under the sea: muffled pressure and swells, a crackling reef all round, and a diver breathing out streams of bubbles.

name: Waterfall
about: The roar of a waterfall pouring into its pool, with drifting spray, from a small cascade to huge falls.

name: Howling wind
about: Wind moaning and howling round the house in long gusts, with windows rattling when it blows hardest.

name: Wind in the trees
about: A breeze moving through the trees, leaves rustling as each gust passes from one tree to the next.

name: Wind
about: Open-air wind that rises and falls in gusts, with a thin whistle and a low rumble in the strong ones.

name: Wolves far off
about: A cold night: a wolf pack howling across the valley, echoing off the far hills, wind in the dark.
